title: Recursive gate tree emission
statement: For a natural number $n$, a gate kind $k$, a list $v$ of natural-number vertex indices, and a list $g$ of gates, define the emitted gate list and output vertex recursively. If $v$ is empty, append a gate of kind $k$ with no arguments to $g$ and return vertex $n+|g|$; if $v$ is a singleton, return $g$ and its sole vertex. Otherwise split $v$ into its first $\lceil |v|/2\rceil$ entries and the remaining entries, recursively emit each part in sequence, then append a gate of kind $k$ whose arguments are the two returned vertices with duplicates removed, and return vertex $n$ plus the length of the resulting gate list.
hypotheses_covered: Input count $n$ is a natural number.
Input is a list of natural-number vertex indices.
Initial gates form a list of gates.
